18 Doha hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on September 29, 2026 for Nov 3 to Nov 5, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Doha hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 14 of the 18 Doha hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: the hotel's own site at 5, Super.com at 3, Vio.com at 2, Agoda at 1, Bluepillow.com at 1, Evendo at 1 and Reserving at 1. These are the Doha rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 10 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, Evendo at 2, Reserving at 2, Vio.com at 2, Agoda at 1, Bluepillow.ca at 1, Bluepillow.com at 1, Etrip.net at 1 and 2 other sites at 2 between them (a tie counts for each site). At the other 8, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 4 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line.
